question: In the DX-Scorecard MBR data model (shared/types.ts Kpi/Snapshot), there is currently no field to persist the computed delta-vs-last-MBR, per-cohort-source deltas, the "Carried" provenance flag, the previous-MBR value ("was {old}"), or the draft's "last edited" timestamp; which new persisted fields should be added to Kpi/Snapshot to back these, given the draft persists to data/snapshots/<id>.json and is later rendered read-only?
recommendation: Add four optional per-KPI fields to `Kpi` and one optional snapshot-level field to `Snapshot`. On `Kpi`: (1) `previousValue?: MetricValue` — the last-MBR value, backing the "was {old}" display and the scalar delta; (2) `delta?: string` — the persisted, pre-computed overall delta-vs-last-MBR display string (e.g. "-0.42 days"); (3) `sourceDeltas?: SubReading[]` — per-cohort-source deltas, reusing the existing `{ label, value }` shape aligned to the cohort breakdown; (4) `carried?: boolean` — an explicit provenance flag replacing the in-memory `carried` Set so "carried over" survives read-only rendering. On `Snapshot`: `lastEditedAt?: string` — an ISO timestamp stamped by the draft's `saveSnapshot`/`editKpi` path. Keep all fields optional so older locked snapshots and freshly seeded drafts remain valid, and let the build/reconcile step compute and stamp them at seed/refresh time rather than deriving them at render.
supporting_points: The `carried` flag is today only React state in MbrBuilderView (a `Set` rebuilt from whether unwired KPIs hold values via `valuedIds`/`seededCarried`); since drafts persist to data/snapshots/<id>.json and later render read-only, provenance must move onto persisted `Kpi.carried` so it isn't lost when the component state is gone.

Deltas and "was {old}" are currently computed at render with no backing field; persisting `previousValue` (typed as the existing `MetricValue`) plus a pre-computed `delta` string, and reusing the existing `SubReading[]` `{label,value}` shape for `sourceDeltas`, keeps cohort deltas structurally aligned with the KPI's cohort `value` and makes read-only rendering a pure display of stored data.

The existing model already stamps per-item timing (`Kpi.asOf`, `Snapshot.generatedAt`, `lockedAt`) and treats all such fields as optional for backward compatibility; adding an optional `Snapshot.lastEditedAt` for the draft's 'last edited' moment follows that established convention and slots naturally into the `editKpi`/`saveSnapshot` persistence path without breaking older locked snapshots.
